baseline_models.focus_anchor: The predication in 'do not make us a fitnah for those who disbelieve' joins ج ع ل, ف ت ن, and the lamed target phrase.
baseline_models.mechanism: Making assigns the speakers a condition or function, while fitnah can be an assay and a means of deflection. The speakers therefore fear not only suffering but becoming the public test-result from which rejecters draw a further false conclusion.

activation_trace.role: Making-as-transformation supplies the assignment of the speakers to a public condition.
Assay and discrimination make the speakers a result to be read, not merely passive sufferers.
Deflection from truth supplies the feared effect that this public result may have on its audience.
Rejection of disclosed truth identifies the audience whose reading may be hardened.

changed_reading.before: Protect us from harm inflicted by disbelievers.
changed_reading.after: Do not let what happens to or through us become an assay that further hardens disbelievers in rejection.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The request not to be made a fitnah is immediately coordinated with 'and forgive us.'
baseline_models.mechanism: The pardon request prevents a wholly externalized account of danger. The speakers admit that their own fault can help produce the misleading condition from which others turn away, so forgiveness repairs a possible causal contribution rather than merely closing a prayer formula.

activation_trace.role: A cause of deflection supplies the outward consequence that the speakers may help generate.
Pardon and protection from a fault's effect make the speakers' own liability part of the mechanism.
Repair and gradual formation frame both prevention and pardon as work upon the speakers.

changed_reading.before: The other group is the sole agent of the trial and the speakers are innocent objects.
changed_reading.after: The speakers ask that their own forgivable failures not become a mechanism that misleads the other group.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled address 'our Lord' encloses the two imperatives, while ج ع ل names a produced state and غ ف ر asks for repair of residue.
baseline_models.mechanism: The prayer has two phases: avert an imposed public role, then cover and repair what remains in the speakers. Repetition turns deliverance into sustained formation rather than a single escape event.

activation_trace.role: Continuance and abiding make the repeated address an enclosure of ongoing care.
Repair and completion give that enclosure a formative function.
Transformation supplies the dangerous state to be averted.
Pardon supplies the second phase, dealing with moral residue rather than public status alone.

changed_reading.before: The verse is a request for one moment of rescue.
changed_reading.after: The verse asks for sustained lordly formation: avert a corrupting role and then repair the community that might occupy it.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The closing pair العزيز الحكيم follows the requests as their operative ground.
baseline_models.mechanism: Overpowering capacity can reverse the speakers' exposed position, but restraint and right judgment govern how that capacity is used. The requested answer is therefore not a mirror-image domination of the other side.

activation_trace.role: Prevailing power supplies the capacity to reverse coercive asymmetry.
Restraint for the sake of repair keeps prevailing power from reproducing corruption.
Knowledge that hits the right judgment supplies measured direction to power.

changed_reading.before: The divine names are a generic assurance that the request can be granted.
changed_reading.after: The names specify the requested mode of rescue: effective enough to reverse exposure and governed enough not to create a new fitnah.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first context ayah places covertly cast affection and proximity beside expulsion and rejection. That mismatch makes the believers' relational conduct a readable surface: they can become a fitnah by obscuring the difference between humane affection, secret dependence, and loyalty to an aggressor.

activation_trace.role: Deflection anchors the changed reading in the focus ayah's feared effect.
Unmediated proximity supplies the porous relation through which the public signal becomes confused.
Casting something toward another turns affection into an enacted transfer, not an inward sentiment only.
Affection supplies the valuable but boundary-sensitive material being transferred.
Concealment makes the relation internally divided and therefore capable of generating a misleading witness.
Hiddenness supplies one side of the explicit hidden-versus-manifest audit.
Manifest disclosure supplies the public side on which the community is read.

structural_cues: 60:1 juxtaposes secret affection with the other party's expulsion of the messenger and believers.
The explicit hidden/manifest pair makes relational incoherence, not affection by itself, the dangerous surface.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies proximity, cast affection, concealment, and public disclosure; I infer that their contradiction can turn the speakers into misleading evidence. A live alternative is the narrower reading of operational leakage with no reputational mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The fitnah is something the hostile group does to the believers from outside.
changed_reading.after: The believers can become the fitnah through a covertly divided relation whose public meaning obscures truth for both sides.

context_deltas.mechanism: The conditional sequence of mastery, extended hands, extended tongues, and the wish for disbelief gives the focus plea an embodied coercive track. Capture can make the believers an arena in which violence and speech pressure seek to manufacture rejection.

activation_trace.role: Affliction and ordeal anchor the bodily exposure named by the changed reading.
Seizing after gaining mastery supplies the condition that delivers the speakers into hostile control.
The released and extended hand supplies coercive reach.
The hand as force makes physical pressure one channel of the trial.
Language and speech make verbal pressure the second channel.
The explicitly desired rejection supplies coercion's intended output.

structural_cues: 60:2 is conditional: mastery is followed by hostile bodily and verbal extension.
The sequence culminates in the wish that the believers reject, joining persecution to an epistemic aim.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies capture, hand-force, speech, and desired rejection; I infer that hostile control tries to process the believers into a visible apostasy-producing arena. The alternative is a simple list of harms without an assay-like causal sequence.

changed_reading.before: The public assay model could remain reputational and indirect.
changed_reading.after: The fitnah also names capture in which hands and speech pressure the believers so that rejection appears as the produced result.

context_deltas.mechanism: Kinship and offspring fail as benefit, separation exposes boundaries, and deeds remain visible. This weakens any reading in which the plural 'us' transfers responsibility into a single communal reputation; the prayer is collective, but the acts that make it misleading remain discriminable.

activation_trace.role: Discrimination within an assay anchors the refusal to treat the plural as morally undifferentiated.
Kinship supplies the collective shelter that the ayah explicitly removes.
Separation that makes a boundary visible disaggregates persons and liabilities.
Intentional deeds supply the individually inspectable substance beneath collective appearance.
Insight of the heart supplies perception beneath kinship labels and public grouping.

structural_cues: 60:3 negates the benefit of kin and children before naming separation and visible deeds.
The focus plural remains a shared prayer, but the context refuses shared identity as a substitute for accountable action.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed kinship benefit, separation, deeds, and perception; I infer an ablation of collective moral cover. The live alternative is that the separation applies only to the final day and does not qualify the social reading of 60:5.

changed_reading.before: The whole community's honor or defeat functions as one undivided sign.
changed_reading.after: The community prays together not to become a misleading sign, while each deed that contributes to that sign remains separable and visible.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding exception moves from Abraham's promise to seek pardon for his father, through an explicit denial of control over the outcome, into a communal prayer that asks pardon for 'us.' The focus request relocates agency: the speakers cannot manage the other's fate, but can entrust the outcome, return, and expose their own need for pardon.

activation_trace.role: The promised request for another person's pardon supplies the direction that the focus prayer reverses.
Disposition and control are explicitly denied, limiting any claim to manage the other's outcome.
Handing the matter over supplies the alternative to controlling the other party.
Return supplies the speakers' self-directed movement back toward their Lord.
Outcome and final becoming place the result beyond the speakers' possession.
The focus's 'forgive us' redirects pardon toward the speakers' own accountable position.

structural_cues: The exception about Abraham's speech is immediately followed by the quoted communal prayer that continues into 60:5.
The pronominal direction changes from seeking pardon 'for you' to asking 'for us.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a pardon promise, denied control, entrustment, return, outcome, and then self-directed pardon; I infer a deliberate recalibration from managing the other to repairing the self. The alternative is that these are adjacent but independent petitions.

changed_reading.before: The speakers primarily ask God to control what disbelievers do to them or conclude about them.
changed_reading.after: The speakers relinquish control of the other's fate and ask that their own unpardoned condition not obstruct the other's path.

context_deltas.mechanism: Hope is followed by a second act of making: God may make affection between present enemies. This positive making answers the focus's negative making. Not becoming fitnah preserves relational space in which an enemy can cease to occupy that role, rather than securing permanent antagonism.

activation_trace.role: The heart's orientation toward what may occur keeps the relation open beyond its present state.
The prohibited transformation supplies the negative half of the mirrored making.
A later transformation supplies the positive answer: a hostile relation can be made into another state.
Present enmity supplies the starting relation without making it permanent.
Affection supplies the surprising relational state into which enmity may be transformed.
Deflection anchors the obstacle whose removal keeps reconciliation possible.

structural_cues: 60:7 repeats the making construction soon after 60:5 but gives it affection between former enemies as its object-state.
The sequence moves from exemplary separation, through the prayer, to hope and possible affection without erasing the prior boundary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies hope, two opposed acts of making, enmity, and affection; I infer that the negative request protects the future possibility enacted by the positive making. The alternative is that 60:7 promises only a separate political change with no semantic answer to 60:5.

changed_reading.before: Do not make us vulnerable while the hostile relation remains fixed.
changed_reading.after: Do not make us a misleading or embittering obstacle that closes the path from present enmity to future affection.

context_deltas.mechanism: The later pair of ayat cuts across a blanket identity division: expansive goodness and justice remain due toward those who did not fight or expel, while prohibited loyalty is tied to fighting, expulsion, and support for expulsion. The speakers could themselves become a fitnah by turning disbelief alone into permission for injustice.

activation_trace.role: The focus's broad audience label supplies the category that the context behaviorally differentiates.
Deflection anchors the danger that unjust conduct can pose to the other party.
Expansive connection and beneficence supply a positive relation to non-aggressors.
Justice supplies the governing criterion across the identity boundary.
Reciprocal fighting supplies one behavior that changes the permitted relation.
Forced movement outside supplies the second behavior that differentiates aggressors.
Withholding a due right names the failure that results when the boundary is governed wrongly.

structural_cues: 60:8 and 60:9 form an explicit did-not-fight-or-expel versus fought-and-expelled contrast.
The legal-social response changes with conduct, while justice remains the positive criterion.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the behavioral contrast and justice; I infer that indiscriminate hostility by believers would itself become a misleading trial for disbelievers. A live alternative is that the hostile referent of 60:5 was already restricted by 60:1 and needs no later qualification.

changed_reading.before: Those who disbelieve form one undifferentiated hostile audience for the prayer.
changed_reading.after: The prayer asks not to become a fitnah to any of them, while the believers' boundary response must distinguish non-aggressors from fighters by justice.

context_deltas.mechanism: The command to examine migrant women, the repeated distinction between divine knowledge and human recognition, and the ensuing judgment establish a bounded assay. This prevents a flat equation of every test with forbidden fitnah: the danger in 60:5 is becoming an uncontrolled, other-facing trial, while 60:10 models examination ordered toward disclosure, protection, and adjudication.

activation_trace.role: Assay and discrimination anchor the semantic comparison with the later examination.
A test that reveals what is inward supplies the context's explicit controlled assay.
Refinement after examination gives the assay a constructive rather than merely destructive direction.
Disclosure to a knower distinguishes divine knowledge from the community's conditional finding.
Adjudication between people bounds what follows from the examination.
Knowledge that reaches the right result ties judgment back to the focus's closing 'Wise.'
The focus epithet anchors wise discrimination as the mode that contains testing.

structural_cues: 60:10 orders examination, then distinguishes what God knows from what the community comes to know.
Detailed consequences follow under the repeated حكم sequence, making the test procedural rather than open-ended.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an explicit revealing test, graded knowledge, and adjudication; I infer a contrast between bounded examination and being made an uncontrolled fitnah. The alternative is simple synonymy: both passages mention testing without intentionally differentiating its direction or governance.

changed_reading.before: The focus asks for release from testing as such.
changed_reading.after: The focus asks not to be turned into an unbounded trial for rejecters; disciplined examination that reveals and protects can coexist with that prayer.

context_deltas.mechanism: Loss of spouses across the boundary is followed by substitute liability and equivalent repayment of expenditure. The sequence activates a material dimension of fitnah: unredressed relational and economic loss can destabilize the community and become visible evidence of disorder, whereas measured compensation prevents the wound from being converted into grievance.

activation_trace.role: Affliction anchors the social wound whose material aftereffects require repair.
Irrecoverable loss supplies the breach that begins the repair sequence.
A joined counterpart supplies the severed relation, not an abstract monetary deficit.
Substitution and guarantee supply the mechanism that transfers liability after loss.
Equivalence supplies the measure that keeps repair proportionate.
Expended wealth supplies the concrete amount restored rather than leaving pardon purely verbal.

structural_cues: 60:11 moves in one sentence from relational loss to an equivalent of what was spent.
The remedy is distributive and measurable, not only affective reconciliation or spiritual pardon.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies loss, a severed pairing, substituted liability, equivalence, and expenditure; I infer that unrepaired imbalance can become the destabilizing public trial feared in 60:5. The alternative is that 60:11 is an independent property settlement with no backward activation.

changed_reading.before: Not becoming a fitnah is chiefly protection of belief, reputation, or bodily safety.
changed_reading.after: Not becoming a fitnah also requires proportionate material repair so cross-boundary loss does not harden into public grievance and disorder.

context_deltas.mechanism: The pledge translates communal identity into a concrete moral inventory, including fabricated accusation and obedience in recognized good, and then joins acceptance to a request for pardon. This strengthens the self-implicating reading: the community avoids becoming a cause of rejection through embodied covenantal credibility and repair after breach.

activation_trace.role: Deflection anchors the reputational consequence of covenantal failure.
A pledged relation of obedience turns identity into publicly undertaken obligations.
A lie that stuns speaker or hearer supplies an acute credibility-destroying act.
Invented falsehood supplies deliberate construction of the misleading sign.
Departure from obedience supplies breach of the pledged moral form.
Recognized good supplies the positive criterion governing obedience rather than mere conformity.
Pardon after the pledge preserves repair without making moral accountability disappear.

structural_cues: 60:12 places a list of embodied prohibitions inside a reciprocal pledge and follows it with an imperative to seek pardon.
The sequence makes forgiveness the repair of accountable agents, matching the focus's immediate 'and forgive us.'
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies pledge, concrete breaches, recognized good, and pardon; I infer that communal credibility is one mechanism by which the speakers can either deflect or cease to deflect outsiders. The alternative is that the pledge governs admission only and does not comment on outsiders' reading.

changed_reading.before: The speakers' possible contribution to fitnah remains a vague admission of moral imperfection.
changed_reading.after: Their contribution becomes covenantally concrete: fabricated claims and breached good can make them a misleading witness, while pardon enables accountable repair.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it cross-activates material images rather than claiming ordinary synonymy. It remains anchored in the adjacent focus roots: fire/assay, truth-covering, and protective covering. Downstream prose should present it as a root-image mechanism, not translate كفر or غفر interchangeably.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places ف ت ن, ك ف ر, and غ ف ر in one short causal request.

activation_trace.role: Fire that burns and blackens supplies an exposing and transforming furnace.
Covering supplies concealment that can hide what the assay should disclose.
Protective covering supplies preservation from the furnace's destructive effect.
Pardon distinguishes preservative covering from concealment that entrenches rejection.

changed_reading.before: The prayer asks to avoid a trial and then separately asks forgiveness.
changed_reading.after: The prayer asks for a protective counter-covering that preserves the speakers through exposure without reproducing the truth-covering attributed to rejection.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because it lets the concrete bridle image illuminate a divine epithet. It remains anchored in the immediate العزيز الحكيم pair and clarifies their functional relation. Downstream prose should say that wisdom is imagined as governing might, not that حكيم lexically means a bridle here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The final two focus words place prevailing power directly beside wisdom/restraint.

activation_trace.role: Overpowering supplies force capable of reversing the speakers' vulnerability.
The bridle image supplies a concrete model of power held to a directed course.
Restraint for repair keeps the image functional rather than decorative.

changed_reading.before: Might and wisdom are two independent grounds for confidence.
changed_reading.after: Wisdom holds prevailing might to a reparative course, so rescue does not become retaliatory fitnah.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads the final grave/despair comparison backward into the focus as an epistemic afterlife of communal failure. It remains anchored in fitnah as deflection and in the explicit sequence joining disbelievers, severed hope, companions, and graves. Downstream prose should qualify it as a possible public-image mechanism, not assert that 60:5 predicts literal death or that fitnah means a grave.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus asks that the speakers not become a deflecting test for disbelievers; 60:13 later shows disbelievers reading from a field of despair and graves.

activation_trace.role: Deflection anchors the possibility that the speakers' apparent end becomes misleading evidence.
Hope cut off supplies the audience state that a failed public sign could intensify.
The same rejecting audience keeps the outlier attached to the focus target.
Persistent companionship makes the grave image a social field, not an isolated object.
Burial supplies the apparent closure from which despairing observers may draw their conclusion.

changed_reading.before: The feared sign lasts only while the believers are visibly defeated or pressured.
changed_reading.after: The prayer may also fear becoming a closed, tomb-like historical result from which disbelievers infer that hope and return are dead.

strongest_changes: The focus-only plea widened from one-way persecution to a bidirectional public assay: the speakers' condition can harden the other party's rejection.
The immediate pardon request implicated the speakers' own conduct instead of leaving all causal agency with their opponents.
The mirrored making of affection in 60:7 recast non-fitnah as preservation of a future path from enmity to affection.
The explicit examination and judgment in 60:10 distinguished a bounded, constructive assay from being made an uncontrolled trial for rejecters.
The later conduct distinction, compensation rule, and pledge extended the prayer into just classification, material repair, and covenantal credibility.
summary.what_was_special: The compact ayah held several coexisting mechanisms at once: coercive ordeal, public evidence, self-implicating failure, formative pardon, and governed power. Context did not collapse them; it added a mirrored positive making, a controlled examination, behavior-sensitive justice, and measurable repair. The oddest live images were protective counter-covering, bridled might, and the risk of becoming tomb-like evidence for despair.
remaining_uncertainties: The lamed phrase can keep different directional emphases alive: audience, affected party, beneficiary, or occasion of the fitnah.
The 60:10 assay and 60:11 compensation may deliberately operationalize 60:5, or may be later procedures that only resonate backward.
The counter-covering, bridle, and tomb models are branch-driven mechanisms and should not be promoted into direct lexical glosses.
